changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientsickleave AS SELECT psl.id, psl.patient_id, psl.encounter_id, psl.start_date, psl.end_date, psl.notes, psl.language, psl.created_date, psl.created_by, psl.last_modified_by, psl.last_modified_date FROM public.patient_sick_leave psl;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientsickleave TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientsickleave FROM report_user;
